rows.title: Apple unveils M5 MacBook Pro lineup starting at $1,599
rows.summary:
• Apple announced its new M5 MacBook Pro lineup starting at $1,599 on Tuesday.
  • The new laptops feature up to 3.5x faster neural processing for local AI models.
  • Shipments are scheduled to begin next Friday across 30 countries.
